name: Percy Jackson
excerpt: Percy Jackson is a twelve-year-old boy who discovers he is a half-blood.
notes:
Percy Jackson is a twelve-year-old boy who attends Yancy Academy, a school designed for troubled kids in upstate New York. He is aware of his identity as a half-blood, a revelation that he finds both dangerous and life-threatening. Percy has a history of getting into trouble, particularly during school field trips, and is currently on probation. During a visit to the Metropolitan Museum of Art, he experiences a series of bizarre events, including a confrontation with his math teacher, Mrs. Dodds, who unexpectedly transforms into a monstrous creature. With the help of a pen that turns into a sword, which was given to him by his Latin teacher, Mr. Brunner, Percy manages to defeat Mrs. Dodds. However, he is left bewildered when no one else seems to remember her existence, leading him to question his own sanity. Throughout this tumultuous experience, Percy relies on his best friend Grover Underwood, who supports him despite his own challenges, and navigates the antagonistic relationship he has with Nancy Bobofit, a fellow student who often bullies him.

Percy Jackson is a twelve-year-old boy navigating the tumultuous waters of adolescence at Yancy Academy, a school for troubled kids in upstate New York. Recently, he has come to terms with the fact that he is a half-blood, a revelation that fills him with both dread and confusion. His life takes a bizarre turn during a field trip to the Metropolitan Museum of Art, where he confronts his math teacher, Mrs. Dodds, who unexpectedly transforms into a monstrous creature. Armed with a pen that transforms into a sword, a gift from his favorite Latin teacher, Mr. Brunner, Percy manages to defeat her. However, the strangeness escalates when he realizes that no one else remembers Mrs. Dodds, leaving him questioning his own sanity. As he grapples with hallucinations and strange weather phenomena, including a thunderstorm that shatters his dorm windows, Percy finds himself expelled from Yancy Academy. Despite his troubles, he cherishes his friendship with Grover Underwood, who stands by him through thick and thin, even as Percy faces the bullying of Nancy Bobofit. The tension mounts when Percy overhears Grover and Mr. Brunner discussing his safety and a mysterious deadline related to the summer solstice, hinting at dangers that lie ahead. On a bus ride with Grover, they encounter three old ladies knitting enormous socks, an unsettling sight that Grover seems to fear, suggesting that their presence is tied to the ominous events unfolding around Percy.
